ui.open-gm-hint: These bindings are not forced. Click to soft-force.
ui.soft-gm-hint: These bindings are soft-forced (may optionally be edited by clients). Click to hard-force, Alt-Click to escape.
ui.hard-gm-hint: These bindings are forced for all clients. Click to release, Alt-Click to escape.
ui.unlocked-gm-hint: These bindings are forced for clients, but the GM has escaped the force. Click to unescape.
ui.hard-client-hint: These bindings are forced by the GM and cannot be edited.
ui.soft-client-hint: These bindings are soft-forced by the GM. Click to unlock editing.
ui.unlocked-client-hint: These bindings are unlocked for this client. Click to reset to the GM's default.
